bio: A pleasingly convivial and relaxed place to eat. If you appreciate high-quality steak cuts, then this restaurant with a trendy urban atmosphere is just the ticket. But the menu also whets your appetite with a host of other dishes and delicious desserts. The sharing options (vegetarian versions available) will give you a good impression of the cuisine here. Popular brunch on Saturdays and Sundays. Tip for car drivers: Public car park Schwabinger Tor....
